Atmosphere.description:
Atmosphere model selection and fallback policy.

Parameters
----------
model : str
    One of ``forecast``, ``wyoming_sounding``, ``standard_atmosphere``,
    ``reanalysis``. Validated at load time (REQ-SCN-03).
file : str or None
    For ``forecast``: GFS ensemble name (default ``"GFS"``).
    For ``reanalysis``: path to a local ERA5-compatible .nc file (required
    when model is ``reanalysis``, REQ-SCN-04).
station : str or None
    Wyoming sounding station id. Required when model is
    ``wyoming_sounding`` (REQ-SCN-05).
fallback : str
    Atmosphere model to use when the primary fetch fails.  Defaults to
    ``"standard_atmosphere"`` (REQ-SCN-06).
Atmosphere.title: Atmosphere

Dispersion.description:
Uncertainty dispersion for a single parameter.

Parameters
----------
std : float
    Standard deviation of the dispersion.
kind : {"relative", "absolute"}
    ``relative`` — std is a fraction of the nominal value (e.g. 0.05 = 5%).
    ``absolute`` — std is in the same units as the nominal (e.g. 2.0°).
    ``kind`` is REQUIRED; absent ``kind`` is a validation error (REQ-SCN-08).

Scenario.description:
Root scenario model.  Returned by :func:`load_scenario`.

Parameters
----------
name : str
    Human-readable label for this scenario (used as default MC output prefix).
site : Site
    Launch site coordinates.  Required.
date : LaunchDate or None
    UTC launch date.  Required when atmosphere.model requires it.
atmosphere : Atmosphere
    Atmosphere model configuration.
rail : Rail or None
    Optional launch rail parameter overrides.
wind : Wind or None
    Optional constant wind measured on the pad. Overrides the atmosphere
    model's wind profile; ``None`` keeps the model's wind.
uncertainty : dict[str, Dispersion] or None
    Per-parameter dispersion budget.  ``None`` signals "not set in YAML"
    so :func:`load_scenario` can fill DEFAULT_UNCERTAINTY.
Scenario.title: Scenario

Launch site coordinates.

    WGS-84 latitude in decimal degrees. Required. Range: -90 to 90.
longitude : float
    WGS-84 longitude in decimal degrees. Required. Range: -180 to 180.
elevation : float or None
    Altitude above sea-level in metres. When absent the elevation from the
    export's ``environment`` block is used (REQ-SCN-10).

Wind.description:
Constant wind measured on the pad (launch-day manual entry).

When present, it replaces the atmosphere model's wind profile with a
constant wind at every altitude (see
:func:`icaro.simulation.build_environment`).

Parameters
----------
speed : float
    Wind speed in m/s (>= 0).
direction_from : float
    Meteorological direction in degrees, 0 <= x < 360: where the wind
    comes FROM, clockwise from north (270 = from the west, blowing east).
Wind.title: Wind

Clear the session cookie. Always succeeds, even on a stale cookie.

Best-effort revokes the underlying refresh token so a captured cookie
value cannot keep verifying after logout.

get.description: Return the caller's identity — lets the browser confirm it's signed in.

post.description:
Verify the Identity Platform ID token and set the session cookie.

401 on an invalid/expired ID token, 403 when the account has no
``org_id`` claim yet — never a 500 (RG-9.4 pattern).

Convert a .ork file to an export directory and persist artifacts.

Multipart upload → ``convert_ork`` → upload export dir to Storage
under ``orgs/{org_id}/exports/{run_id}/`` → save ExportRecord (and a new
RocketRecord unless ``rocket_id`` was given) to Db → returns
``{export_id, rocket_id, manifest}`` where both ids are logical run_id slugs.

Every file becomes its own rocket unless the user explicitly picks one of
the org's rockets with ``rocket_id``; nothing is inferred from the filename.

On ``ConvertUnavailableError``: 503 with the install hint verbatim.
On non-.ork file: 422.
On unknown / other-org ``rocket_id``: 404, before the conversion runs.
Never returns a Python traceback (RG-9.4).

Satisfies RG-2.1, AC-RG-2.1, AC-RG-2.2, REQ-01.1, REQ-02.1, REQ-03.1.

get.description:
Look up ground elevation at the given coordinates.

Best-effort: on failure returns 503 (AC-RG-2.9).  The UI must handle
this gracefully (show manual-entry fallback, never block simulate).

Satisfies RG-2.7, AC-RG-2.9.

Return the export record including its manifest.

Returns 404 if the export_id is not found OR not owned by the caller's org.

Return a paginated list of simulations in reverse-chronological order.

Each item includes the denormalized rocket ``name`` and the simulated
export's ``ork_filename`` (join-on-read — see module docstring).

Parameters
----------
limit : int
    Maximum number of records (default: 20, max: 100).
before : datetime | None
    Cursor — return only simulations created before this timestamp.
rocket_id : str | None
    If given, only the runs of that rocket (any of its exports).

Satisfies REQ-05.1, REQ-05.2, REQ-05.3.

get.description: Status, progress and (once done) the summary result of one run.
The landing/apogee ellipses as KML; 404 until done or when not produced.

Real MT1 flights published by the telemetry service, newest first.

``enabled: false`` with no flights when the caller's organization is not
in ``ICARO_INTEROP_ORGS`` (or the variable is unset). Documents without a
valid summary (no id) are skipped.

One real flight: the full ``mt-interop/real-flight@1`` document.

404 when the feature is off for the caller's organization or the flight
does not exist.

Return the result for a completed run in forward-compat job-status shape.

Response shape: ``{run_id, status: "done", result}``

The shape is designed for forward-compat with an async/polling upgrade
(ADR-6): when simulate becomes async, this endpoint will return
``{run_id, status: "running"|"done"|"error", progress?, result?}`` and
the client polls — no contract break.

Fetches ``{result_prefix}result.json`` via the Storage seam (REQ-02.4),
where ``result_prefix`` comes from the resolved SimRecord (issue #45).
Returns 404 if the run is absent or not owned by the caller's org.

Compare a run (the caller's org) with a real flight, from stored data only.

404 when the feature is off for the organization, the run is not the
organization's or does not exist, the flight does not exist, or the run
has no stored flight data. 422 when the real flight document does not
follow ``mt-interop/real-flight@1``. Runs simulated before the interop
artefact existed compare approximately (``approximate: true`` plus a
``sim_approximate`` warning).

Serve a plot PNG from Storage.

Fetches ``{result_prefix}{name}.png`` via the Storage seam (REQ-02.5),
where ``result_prefix`` comes from the resolved SimRecord (issue #45).
Returns 404 if the run is absent or not owned by the caller's org, or the
plot blob itself is missing. PNGs are the artifacts most likely to be
linked or embedded directly, so this check applies here too, not just to
the JSON endpoints (issue #44).

The ``name`` segment is sanitised (``Path.name``) to prevent directory
traversal — same guard as the previous local-disk implementation.

Return the resampled flight time-series for a completed run (issue #11).

Shape: ``{t, altitude, speed, mach, acceleration, path3d}`` — plain JSON
arrays sharing one ``t`` axis, written by ``serialize_flight`` at simulate
time. Powers the interactive 2D charts and the animated 3D trajectory.

Fetches ``{result_prefix}series.json`` via the Storage seam (REQ-02.6),
where ``result_prefix`` comes from the resolved SimRecord (issue #45).
Returns 404 if the run is absent, not owned by the caller's org, or the
blob itself is missing (e.g. an old run predating this feature) — the
client then falls back to the static PNG plots. Additive endpoint.

Parameters

get.description:
Return the rocket and its exports (newest first).

Both lookups are scoped to the caller's org in the ``Db`` layer, so a
rocket_id that exists in another org is indistinguishable from a missing one.
Returns 404 if the rocket_id is not found OR not owned by the caller's org.

patch.description:
Rename a rocket of the caller's org; returns the updated summary.

The name is trimmed and must be 1-120 characters (422 otherwise). Only the
rocket record holds the name: exports keep the design name read from their
file, and runs read the rocket's name live, so nothing else is rewritten.
Returns 404 if the rocket_id is not found OR not owned by the caller's org.

get.description:
Return a starter Scenario dict with DEFAULT_UNCERTAINTY and PRESETS.

The UI uses this as its initial form state — it never starts empty.
Satisfies AC-RG-2.3, RG-2.2.

post.description:
Validate and normalize a scenario dict.

On success: returns the normalized Scenario dict (HTTP 200).
On failure: returns HTTP 422 with field-keyed error list.
Never leaks a Python traceback (RG-9.4).

Satisfies AC-RG-2.4, RG-2.3, AC-RG-3.9.
